briefing: NASDAQ -0.1% and S&P 500 +0.1% today — a neutral, directionless session with no strong signal either way. Cash is well below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we held all 7 existing positions rather than forcing a buy on a low-conviction day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off describes a cautious stance where investors hold back from new positions because market signals aren't strong enough to justify the risk. Today, with cash below the deployment threshold and no clear momentum, sitting tight was the disciplined choice rather than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」(Risk-Off)是指投資者因市場訊號不夠強烈,而選擇保持謹慎、不建立新倉位的策略。今日現金水平低於部署門檻,且市況缺乏明確動力,按兵不動才是穩健之道,而非勉強交易。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ dipping slightly and the S&P 500 ticking up marginally, reflecting a lack of strong catalysts on either side. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, trading stayed range-bound. No significant news events drove today's price action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡,納斯達克指數微跌0.1%,標普500指數則微升0.1%,反映市場缺乏明顯的利好或利淡因素。由於沒有清晰的風險偏好或避險訊號,大市維持窄幅波動。今日並無重大新聞事件左右價格走勢。
